intro: まで keeps its image of a finishing line, but here the line is pushed further than anyone expected. X まで means the list or the effort reached as far as X: not only the usual things, but even X. It adds a surprising item on top of others, usually in an affirmative sentence.

skills.rule: To add a surprising last item to a list, even X on top of everything else, put まで after X.
skills.explain:
まで as even says the reach of something went all the way to an item you would not expect: 子供まで知っている (even the children know it), 雨だけでなく雷まで鳴り出した (not just rain, there was even thunder). The feeling is escalation: things went further than normal, which can be pleasant or annoying.

まで replaces が and を: 弟まで来た, お弁当まで作ってくれた (までが is also used for a subject: 弟までが来た). Other particles stay in front of it: 外国にまで, 夢にまで. After a て-form it means go so far as to: 並んでまで買いたくない (I would not go so far as to queue for it).

The edge is with さえ. さえ picks the minimum, the case that should have been easy, and is at home in negatives: 名前さえ書けない (can't even write his name). まで piles on an extra, and is at home in affirmatives: 名前まで覚えてくれた (she even remembered my name). も is the plain also or even, with no sense of escalation. Do not confuse this with まで meaning until or as far as a place (五時まで, 駅まで).
patterns: Aだけでなく B まで
[て-form] まで [verb] (go so far as to)

examples.jp: その歌[うた]は子供[こども]{まで}知[し]っています。
雨[あめ]だけでなく、風[かぜ]{まで}強[つよ]くなってきた。
examples.en: It's not just the rain; now even the wind has picked up.

examples.jp: 田中[たなか]さんは私[わたし]の誕生日[たんじょうび]{まで}覚[おぼ]えていてくれた。
examples.en: Mr Tanaka even remembered my birthday.

examples.jp: 仕事[しごと]のことを夢[ゆめ]に{まで}見[み]ます。
並[なら]んで{まで}買[か]いたくはないです。
examples.en: I wouldn't go so far as to queue to buy it.

contrast.note: さえ is the extreme minimum, mostly in negatives (平仮名さえ読めない, can't even read hiragana). まで is an extreme extra, mostly in affirmatives (漢字まで読める, can even read kanji).
弟も来た is my brother came too. 弟まで来た is even my brother came, which nobody expected.
だけ restricts to only X. まで extends the list to include X. They point in opposite directions.

mistakes.bad: 弟[おとうと]が{まで}来[き]ました。
mistakes.good: 弟[おとうと]{まで}来[き]ました。
mistakes.note: まで replaces が and を; it does not follow them.

mistakes.bad: 疲[つか]れて、平仮名[ひらがな]{まで}読[よ]めなかった。
mistakes.good: 疲[つか]れて、平仮名[ひらがな]{さえ}読[よ]めなかった。
mistakes.note: Couldn't even do the easiest thing is the minimum case, which is さえ. まで adds an unexpected extra; it does not mark the easiest case.

skills.tip: Even X, on top of all the rest? まで. Not even X, the easiest one? さえ.
